sayDuring: ⛔ THE HERALD does not notice you the way prey notices a hunter. It notices you the way weather notices a field. You cannot face this alone — sound the call, muster 10 allied blades (you have 6). This is not courage. This is arithmetic.

callLines.line: 📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.

anchoredLines.line: 🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 1 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Omar Reyes. From Thornfield." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
The fire is quieter on hungry mornings. Nobody has spare breath for talking.
The fire is quieter on hungry mornings. Nobody has spare breath for talking.

🌪️ THE HERALD struck Thornfield in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold answers! Peter Moreau and Maya Park will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Stonebridge answers! Jesse Silva and Lena Marsh will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Priya Park and Oscar Santos will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)

🛡️ Elif, Priya step forward. They will march with the muster, eat from your stores (1000 kcal/day each), and stand in front of THE HERALD. They can die — Haven does not get them back, and the fire will be quieter. Tap again — Haven sends its own.
🛡️ Haven commits its own: Elif, Priya march with the muster. Not loaned. Not asked-for. Ours. The coalition counts 8 blades against THE HERALD — it needs 10.
🍽️ The muster is hungry — 0 of 8,000 kcal fed. Bellies remember who feeds them. (loyalty strains when the food runs thin.) (trust −2 per fire per day while the muster stands hungry.)
